sources.title: A Guide to the Go Garbage Collector

corrections: Updated GOMAXPROCS guidance for Go 1.25 container-aware defaults and marked scheduler constants as implementation details.
Removed fixed GC pause-duration promises and corrected root scanning and GC CPU-impact wording.
Corrected the GOGC target formula to include GC roots and described GOMEMLIMIT as a soft limit.
Corrected the hybrid write barrier introduction from Go 1.14 to Go 1.8.
Updated Timer and Ticker guidance for Go 1.23 synchronous timer channels, garbage collection, and Stop/Reset guarantees, with legacy-module boundaries.
Removed fixed nanosecond claims for stack and heap allocation.
Promoted reviewed runtime, allocation, GC, timer, profiling, escape-analysis, and tuning relationships.
